label: Risk State
definition: State of the risk-relevant context distinct from workflow processing.
transition_rule_policy: No universal transition graph in OWL; evidence/rule/application specific.
conflicts: Resolved situational boundary in foundational/risk-state-semantic-boundary-v0.1.md; management escalation is not Core Risk State.

label: Workflow State
definition: Operational processing state of a Risk Register Entry or management workflow.
source_values_or_examples: Open; Analyzed; Treated; Closed; Completed; Reviewed; Ready
temporal_pattern: one current snapshot plus historical state records where available
transition_rule_policy: Workflow transitions belong to application/rule/state-machine layer, not OWL universal truth.

label: Pre-treatment Assessment Context
definition: Assessment context relative to a specified before-control baseline; not a state of Risk.
source_values_or_examples: inherent/pre-control; gross requires an explicit framework mapping
transition_rule_policy: No automatic transition to post-treatment without assessment/treatment evidence.
conflicts: Not a separate Risk; gross is not an automatic synonym; distinguish projected and observed assessment bases.

label: Post-treatment Assessment Context
definition: Assessment context relative to a specified after-control baseline; the basis may be projected or observed.
source_values_or_examples: residual/after-control baseline; projected or observed basis must be explicit
transition_rule_policy: Reassessment can supersede result while preserving history.
conflicts: Not a separate Risk and not proof that a planned control was executed or effective.

label: Evidence Validity Context
definition: Context/version interval within which an Evidence Item or provenance claim is applicable/current.
transition_rule_policy: No universal state enumeration; governed by provenance/versioning.

label: Responsibility Assignment Validity
definition: Validity interval/state of a responsibility/owner assignment.
transition_rule_policy: Assignment lifecycle separate from actor identity and risk lifecycle.
conflicts: Responsibility-grounding contract resolves aboutness versus mediation; qualified interval behavior is tested in the Run 3 companion profile.
